title: Answer: humans, many animals, and anything with the brain’s causal powers

statements.text: Humans are conscious, and so are animals such as apes, monkeys and dogs. Searle has no view yet on fleas, grasshoppers, crabs or snails. A machine could be conscious if it had the causal powers of a brain, and no computer is conscious by its program alone.

sources.quote: we find it completely natural to ascribe intentionality to members of certain other primate species such as apes and monkeys and to domestic animals such as dogs

sources.locator: p. 200, quoting The Rediscovery of the Mind, p. 74
